analytics.raw_text: Raman spectrum of tembotrione crystal modification II, the single full-page plot captioned Fig. 2. Abscissa printed Wellenzahl cm-1; the ordinate carries no axis title and no unit. No band position is recorded here. The exact band maxima in wavenumbers are printed in Tabelle 1 for the Raman spectra and Tabelle 2 for the infrared spectra of the description; the positions in the sheet transcription were read off the plot only approximately, to no better than a few tens of cm-1, and are not measurements.

notes: The same molecule as tembotrione, same atoms and same bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is metastable crystal modification II and not a distinct chemical entity. This section is a drawing sheet: it carries one spectrum plot and no chemical structure, no procedure and no quantity, so the only compound content is the substance the spectrum was measured on. Which modification this sheet shows is an inference, not a reading: the sheet prints only the caption Fig. 2 and names no substance at all. The assignment to tembotrione crystal modification II, and with it whether the plot is the Raman or the infrared spectrum, is taken from [0018] at line 96 of the description, on a different page, which states that Abbildung 2, the label [0018] uses for this sheet, shows the Raman spectrum of crystal modification II of tembotrione. The sheets print Fig. 2 while [0018] calls the same object Abbildung 2. No alias is carried on this record. No German name of any modification, and in fact no German name of any substance, appears anywhere in this section's own lines, so there is no spelling here to record as an alias; the description's spellings reach the merged record from the sections that do print them. No band position from this sheet is recorded as data: every position in the sheet transcription is flagged there as approximate, and the exact band maxima are in Tabelle 1 (Raman) and Tabelle 2 (infrared) of the description, which belong to those sections and not to this one.
